$note: Machine-readable realization ledger for the Unity game-pause-menu lane after the parity rebuild. Generated components are consumed through public exports only; every region below the generated surface is a ledgered fallback so a later package admission or consumer helper can swap it mechanically. All geometry, colour and type values come from fixtures/parity-layout.json (copied verbatim into the lane and parsed by the lane adapter).

fallbacks.mechanism: UnityEngine.UIElements.Slider with its theme internals styled inline from the layout authority (300x6 graphite track, 16px circular boneBright thumb) plus a lane-drawn signal fill overlay clipped to the thumb's left edge
fallbacks.needed: generated Slider with min/max/step/value and a fill element
fallbacks.reason: Unity allowlist admits no Slider; the engine slider has a tracker and dragger but no fill element
fallbacks.swap: replace BuildSlider with the generated control; step snapping becomes the component's step prop and the fill overlay disappears

fallbacks.mechanism: UnityEngine.UIElements.DropdownField with theme internals (input/arrow) styled inline from the layout authority (graphite fill, ruleStrong border, boneBright text, muted chevron)
fallbacks.needed: generated Select with option list and value channel; the web contract already exists

fallbacks.mechanism: absolute header/footer container regions; every text, badge and rule inside is a generated component
fallbacks.needed: not a component contract; app shell chrome
fallbacks.reason: shell layout is app-level chrome owned by the app spec

fallbacks.mechanism: sage field with 60px grid lines (ink 12%), 12px corner ticks, generated Button marker squares with monogram text, and a generated Popover at the pinned popover rect
fallbacks.needed: not a component contract; map plotting surface
fallbacks.reason: graphic-grammar region owned by the app spec, not the component corpus

fallbacks.mechanism: absolute paper panel at the pinned drawer rect; dossier/brief/history/perks/parts composed from generated Text, Divider, Badge and Button children
fallbacks.needed: generated Drawer/Sheet surface that can render non-modally at a pinned rect
fallbacks.reason: the admitted Sheet is a modal/portal surface; parity pins a non-modal overlay at an absolute rect
fallbacks.swap: follow-on: replace the container with Sheet and pass the pinned rect + non-modal mode

fallbacks.mechanism: full-viewport dim overlay plus a panel at the pinned remap-modal rect; prompt/actions are generated Text/Button children, key capture is the lane's root key handler
fallbacks.needed: generated Dialog with a deterministic panel rect and external key-capture hook
fallbacks.reason: the admitted Dialog is a portal surface with its own open/close contract; parity pins the exact panel rect and the capture state
fallbacks.swap: follow-on: replace the overlay container with Dialog once its rect/portal behaviour is pinned

fallbacks.mechanism: coloured 576x26 strip plus generated Text for the preview line and language/background meta
fallbacks.needed: not a component contract; live preview decoration
fallbacks.reason: app-level preview chrome, no component admits a subtitle preview

fallbacks.mechanism: generated Tabs cells pinned to 320x56 boxes; active fill and label colour applied inline from the layout authority on the generated is-selected state class (the generated sheet's selected-tab selector is a documented uss-selector gap)
fallbacks.needed: a generated selected-tab style rule that can be themed
fallbacks.reason: consumer styling of an admitted component's state class, not a fallback

fallbacks.mechanism: generated Switch at size lg with lane-USS stadium radii pinned explicitly (track 64x32 r16, thumb 24x24 r12, checked offset 36px) instead of the generated 9999px pill token; on/off colours inline from the layout authority
fallbacks.needed: a generated track-radius that projects to a stadium instead of an ellipse
fallbacks.reason: generated border-radius projects the token 9999px verbatim and Unity paints an ellipse (the 'pinched oval' defect)
fallbacks.swap: package-side fix can then delete the lane override

fallbacks.mechanism: portable two-letter code tiles: 16x16 icon-row tiles (explicit fixture-icon -> code table) and 40x40 ability-card tiles (first two alphanumeric characters of the ability name), graphite fill with a 1px ruleStrong border, square corners and centred boneBright 800 text at 8/12 px
fallbacks.needed: a portable icon rendering mode (glyph -> text code) inside the admitted Icon component
fallbacks.reason: the parity authority pins a portable icon language because GPUI has no Icon component; catalog glyphs are not portable across the three engines
fallbacks.swap: never on these two parity surfaces (app-authority decision); generated Icon remains available elsewhere

admitted_not_used: Icon (admitted; the parity authority pins portable code tiles on the two icon surfaces)
and the rest of the Unity target's 48-component allowlist (this app shape needs the listed subset)
non_claims: Native slider/dropdown internals are styled to the pinned geometry but keep Unity theme behaviour; no cross-engine interaction parity is claimed for them.
Hand-authored shell, map plot, drawer, modal and preview regions are app decoration, not design-system realizations.
All colour/geometry claims are for the 1280x800 capture states declared in the layout authority.
